summary: @onereach/types-contacts-api ships obfuscated preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute opaque bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscated script (hex-mangled `_0xXXXX` identifiers, string-array dictionary lookups) that checks PATH for `bun`, and if absent downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip` into an OS tmpdir, extracts it, chmods it executable (`chmodSync(_,493)`), and then `execFileSync`s the downloaded Bun binary against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle obfuscated with a string-array rotator (`WV8StW` over dictionary `n7gIxM`) and hex-mangled identifiers, with no readable behavior. The package is nominally a generated TypeScript types package (`@onereach/types-contacts-api`) — a types-only package has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to execute a large opaque bundle. The alternate-runtime shell-out also has the effect of hiding the executed code from tooling that only inspects Node-resolved modules. `npm install` of this package causes automatic execution of the obfuscated bundle on the installer's machine with the installer's user privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
